name: Bayesian Hyperparameter Optimization for Volume Rendering
definition: A multi-objective optimization process to select hyperparameters for HKTex UV-texture and multi-view image fitting, minimizing model storage size and mean squared errors across rendered views.
summary: Bayesian Hyperparameter Optimization for Volume Rendering automates HKTex fitting by using a Tree-Structured Parzen Estimator to balance reconstruction fidelity and storage size across over 30 parameters.
